name: 성호전자
ai_comment:
The stock's strength is likely driven by the Hong Kong listing of Robotechnic, which highlighted the value of Sungho Electronics' optical communication and semiconductor supply chains. Additionally, momentum was further supported by news that the company newly acquired an 8.78% stake in Global Technology.

name: 한양디지텍
ai_comment:
The stock is outperforming the index primarily due to rising expectations that it will benefit from an improving AI semiconductor industry. Additionally, strong institutional buying with six consecutive days of net purchases has further propelled its upward momentum.
